extracted.name: Rotisserie Chicken Salad
extracted.description: This creamy rotisserie chicken salad with hard-boiled eggs, pickle relish, and mayo is easy to prep for a flavorsome salad for summer parties.
ingredient_lines: 5 pounds deli rotisserie chicken, boned and meat chopped
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Combine chicken, onion, eggs, pickle relish, mustard, paprika, and red pepper flakes in a bowl; stir in mayonnaise by spoonfuls until mixture holds together but isn't too moist. Season with salt and pepper.
